name: Zelda's Lullaby
learnedFrom: Impa, after meeting Zelda in Hyrule Castle
effect: Activates Triforce symbols to open doors and trigger Royal Family events

name: Saria's Song
learnedFrom: Saria, at the Sacred Forest Meadow
effect: Contacts Saria for hints and unlocks Darunia's dance in Goron City

name: Epona's Song
effect: Fills empty bottles with milk; as adult, summons Epona if you already have her

name: Sun's Song
learnedFrom: The Composer Brothers' grave, Kakariko Graveyard
effect: Instantly toggles day and night; briefly stuns ReDeads and Gibdos

name: Song of Time
learnedFrom: Zelda's message at the Temple of Time, after gathering all 3 Spiritual Stones
effect: Opens the Door of Time; moves or removes blue Time Blocks

name: Song of Storms
learnedFrom: Guru-Guru, in the Kakariko windmill (as adult)
effect: Summons rain; instantly grows Magic Beans and reveals hidden holes

name: Minuet of Forest
learnedFrom: Sheik, in the Sacred Forest Meadow maze
effect: Warps to the Sacred Forest Meadow, beside the Forest Temple

name: Bolero of Fire
learnedFrom: Sheik, atop Goron City after clearing the path with the Hookshot
effect: Warps to Death Mountain Crater, beside the Fire Temple

name: Serenade of Water
learnedFrom: Sheik, at Lake Hylia after leaving the Ice Cavern
effect: Warps to Lake Hylia, beside the Water Temple

name: Nocturne of Shadow
learnedFrom: Sheik, at Kakariko Graveyard after clearing the Water Temple
effect: Warps to the Graveyard, beside the Shadow Temple

name: Requiem of Spirit
learnedFrom: Sheik, at Desert Colossus after rescuing the carpenters with the Hover Boots
effect: Warps to Desert Colossus, beside the Spirit Temple

name: Prelude of Light
learnedFrom: Sheik, at the Temple of Time pedestal after clearing any adult temple
effect: Warps to the Temple of Time

name: Scarecrow's Song
learnedFrom: Compose 8 notes for Bonooru (child), then repeat them for Pierre (adult)
effect: Summons a scarecrow platform wherever you play the melody afterward
